confidence_notes: Zakopane restaurant estimates are supported by July 2026 local price data, but Numbeo reports only nine contributors over the past 18 months. Cocktail and wine-glass prices were estimated from the local draft-beer price and wine-bottle reference because direct glass prices were unavailable. Hostel prices shown were starting rates, and the 3-star hotel average was date-sensitive; annual accommodation estimates are therefore less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; direct Zakopane price references informed the estimates.
